name: MailMergeFields
description: A collection of MailMergeField objects that represent the mail merge related fields in a document.
remarks: Use the Fields property to return the MailMergeFields collection. The following example adds an ASK field after the last mail merge field in the active document. Use the Add method to add a merge field to the MailMergeFields collection. The following example replaces the selection with a MiddleInitial merge field. Use Fields (Index), where Index is the index number, to return a single MailMergeField object. The following example displays the field code of the first mail merge field in the active document. The MailMergeFields collection has additional methods, such as AddAsk and AddFillIn, for adding fields related to a mail merge operation.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified MailMergeFields object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of mail merge fields in the collection. Read-only.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an individual MailMergeField object in a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The individual object to be returned. Can be a Long indicating the ordinal position of the individual object.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Range As Range, Name As String) As MailMergeField
methods.description: Returns a MailMergeField object that represents a mail merge field added to the data source document.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The range where you want the field to appear. This field replaces the range, if the range isn't collapsed.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the field.

methods.name: AddAsk
methods.signature: AddAsk(Range As Range, Name As String, [Prompt As Variant], [DefaultAskText As Variant], [AskOnce As Variant]) As MailMergeField
methods.description: Adds an ASK field to a mail merge main document. Returns a MailMergeField object.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The location for the ASK field.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The bookmark name that the response or default text is assigned to. Use a REF field with the bookmark name to display the result in a document.

parameters.name: Prompt
parameters.description: The text that's displayed in the dialog box.

parameters.name: DefaultAskText
parameters.description: The default response, which appears in the text box when the dialog box is displayed. Corresponds to the \d switch for an ASK field.

parameters.name: AskOnce
parameters.description: True to display the dialog box only once instead of each time a new record is merged. Corresponds to the \o switch for an ASK field.

methods.name: AddFillIn
methods.signature: AddFillIn(Range As Range, [Prompt As Variant], [DefaultFillInText As Variant], [AskOnce As Variant]) As MailMergeField
methods.description: Adds a FILLIN field to a mail merge main document. Returns a MailMergeField object.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The location for the FILLIN field.

parameters.name: Prompt
parameters.description: The text that's displayed in the dialog box.

parameters.name: DefaultFillInText
parameters.description: The default response, which appears in the text box when the dialog box is displayed. Corresponds to the \d switch for an FILLIN field.

parameters.name: AskOnce
parameters.description: True to display the prompt only once instead of each time a new record is merged. Corresponds to the \o switch for a FILLIN field. The default value is False.

methods.name: AddIf
methods.signature: AddIf(Range As Range, MergeField As String, Comparison As WdMailMergeComparison, [CompareTo As Variant], [TrueAutoText As Variant], [TrueText As Variant], [FalseAutoText As Variant], [FalseText As Variant]) As MailMergeField
methods.description: Adds an IF field to a mail merge main document. Returns a MailMergeField object.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The location for the IF field.

parameters.name: MergeField
parameters.description: The merge field name.

parameters.name: Comparison
parameters.description: The operator used in the comparison.

parameters.name: CompareTo
parameters.description: The text to compare with the contents of MergeField.

parameters.name: TrueAutoText
parameters.description: The AutoText entry that's inserted if the comparison is true. If this argument is specified, TrueText is ignored.

parameters.name: TrueText
parameters.description: The text that's inserted if the comparison is true.

parameters.name: FalseAutoText
parameters.description: The AutoText entry that's inserted if the comparison is false. If this argument is specified, FalseText is ignored.

parameters.name: FalseText
parameters.description: The text that's inserted if the comparison is false.

methods.name: AddSet
methods.signature: AddSet(Range As Range, Name As String, [ValueText As Variant], [ValueAutoText As Variant]) As MailMergeField
methods.description: Adds a SET field to a mail merge main document. Returns a MailMergeField object.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The location for the SET field.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The bookmark name that ValueText is assigned to.

parameters.name: ValueText
parameters.description: The text associated with the bookmark specified by the Name argument.

parameters.name: ValueAutoText
parameters.description: The AutoText entry that includes text associated with the bookmark specified by the Name argument. If this argument is specified, ValueText is ignored.
